prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: one zucchini, three eggs, a chunk of cheese — one second still. Then motion: zucchini ribbons peeled fast in a green cascade, softening in olive oil, eggs whisked and poured over in a slow golden flood, cheese snowing on top. Money shot: under the broiler the top puffs and blisters golden — the pan emerging, a wedge cut and lifted with the tender green layers steaming inside, cheese pulling at the cut, backlit. Final beat: the wedge on a plate, fork pressing through. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the ribbon peel, then the egg flood. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: a fritada alta de abobrinha — a abobrinha esquecida da gaveta virando jantar leve de verdade. **Sábado que vem: [A] calabresa, cebola e batata ou [B] arroz de ontem, queijo e tomate? Comenta A ou B 👇**
